thread:
FinanceOps: Morning — reconciliation job flagged ~320 NetSuite credit memos that don't match any Stripe invoice id. Generated report: /reports/2025-02-11/orphan_credits.csv
Liam: I'm seeing a pattern: importer wrote external_ref using invoice.number when present, but for older invoices invoice.number was null and we stored an empty string. That breaks the 1:1 mapping.
Zoe: Yep. Sample rows show external_ref = '' and memo amounts that exactly equal some Stripe credit_note amounts within a 1-day window. Likely safe to auto-match with confidence=0.98 for many.
BillingBot: ALERT: orphan_credits_count=320 > threshold (200). Ticket FIN-2042 created.
Liam: Quick fix: change importer to prefer invoice.id (programmatic id) and only fallback to number if id missing. Patch ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/601
SRE: Also noticed spike in webhook retries around 2025-02-10 03:00 UTC due to a short DB failover. That could've left some events partially processed.
Zoe: Proposed remediation plan: 1) run a dry-run matcher that outputs candidate mappings with confidence, 2) auto-apply matches >=0.95, 3) queue lower confidence ones for manual review. We'll include NS batch ids in CSV.
FinanceOps: Approve dry-run. Please ensure accounting columns: net_credit_id, ns_batch_id, candidate_stripe_id, delta_amount, confidence, notes.
Liam: Will run now against last 7 days. SQL used: 
```
select c.id as net_credit_id, c.amount, ns.batch_id as ns_batch_id, s.id as stripe_id,
       abs(c.amount - s.amount) as delta,
       case when abs(c.amount - s.amount) < 0.5 then 0.99 else 0.6 end as confidence
from net_credits c
left join stripe_credit_notes s on c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  and date_trunc('day', c.created_at) between s.created_at - interval '1 day' and s.created_at + interval '1 day'
where c.external_ref = '';
```
Liam: Dry-run CSV uploaded to FIN-2042.
BillingBot: CSV available at https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2042?file=orphan_match_dryrun.csv
Zoe: Can we add an alert to signal when importer writes external_ref = '' more than 50 times a day? That will catch regressions.
FinanceOps: Added alert rule. Also action items: (A) deploy importer patch (Liam), (B) run auto-apply on high-confidence rows during maintenance window 18:00-18:30 PT (Zoe + Accounting), (C) postmortem for DB failover impact (SRE).
SRE: We'll add a retry/backoff adjustment so webhook consumers back off faster during DB unavailability to avoid partial writes.
NetSuiteSyncBot: Maintenance window scheduled 2025-02-11 18:00-18:30 PT.
FinanceOps: Thanks — keep updates here and upload final reconciliation CSV after run.
